title.en: Turn Notes into a BPMN Diagram
title.zh: 会议记录转 BPMN 流程图

prompt.en: Generate an end-to-end process flow diagram based on these raw stakeholder notes, one lane per role, decisions as flow.
prompt.zh: 根据这份原始的与会者会议记录，生成一张端到端的流程图，每个角色对应一条泳道，决策点用流程节点表示。

reply.en: BPMN diagram complete and visually reviewed. Modeled as 5 lanes (split by the participant roles in §2 of the meeting minutes, plus automated system behavior): Marketing Operations, Ecosystem Partnerships, Sales Representative, CRM System (automated), and Sales Director; with 8 decision gateways.
reply.zh: BPMN 流程图已完成并通过视觉复核。模型结构为 5 条泳道（按会议记录 §2 参会角色 + 系统自动化行为拆分）：Marketing Operations、Ecosystem Partnerships、Sales Representative、CRM System（自动化）、Sales Director；共 8 个判定网关。

caption.en: BPMN diagram — CRM Lead Ownership, Visibility & Follow-up Governance Process
caption.zh: BPMN 流程图 —— CRM 线索归属、可见性与跟进治理流程
